content.title: Your next pay date moved from 4 December to 7 December

body.text: Payroll moved the pay date for the period 16 to 29 November from Friday 4 December to Monday 7 December. Reason given: the bank holiday schedule. Changes to your pay settings for this pay date are still accepted until Tuesday 1 December at 17:00. Open Payleaf to see your pay calendar.
